name: @pwa-kit/settings
description: pwa-kit: settings for a React PWA, declared once (defineSetting), a registry that checks and applies a change over injected storage, one searched list of rows that hides what does not apply (a detail whose setting is off, a group with nothing to show) and a SettingsHome of groups and a search box. Sections, groups and storage are the app's, passed in as arguments. React.
